en.title: System Maintenance Notice
en.content: The system is currently unavailable due to backend update and maintenance operations. Services are expected to resume at 3:00 PM on August 13, 2026. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

zh.title: 系統維護通知
zh.content: 因系統後台進行更新維護作業，目前暫停使用，預計2026/8/13 下午15:00恢復運作，造成不便敬請見諒。
